notes.title: Progress report: Trailblazer
notes.content:
[p]Hi everybody! ːPhhelperː [/p][p]I wanted to do a super small quick update note since I have been silent for almost 2 months (more dev work, less writing updates ːPfrogː )— I am currently working on the ability/skill tree system and wanted to show something from it. This is the TRAILBLAZER ability that belongs to the Incendiary Ammo ability tree. This powerful ability will ignite the ground as the bullet travels and burn anything in its path. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882185/7d3768c8640182e9148163de2861c0a0686a5b51.gif"][/img][/p][p]It is really fun to make these different abilities and skills and I am trying my best to not just make it boring stat and number boosts (though there will be those also of course). [/p][p][/p][p]And if you have some fun ideas for abilities / gear or skills for the survivor and his dogs don't hesitate to share them in the forums or on [url="https://discord.com/invite/X3RmAfjBa3"]Discord[/url]! I read all suggestions and feedback I get.  [/p][p][/p][p]And if you think the game looks interesting so far, please consider wishlisting it as it helps a lot! ːPfishː[/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1256730/No_Life/"][/dynamiclink]You can also follow my [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/varagtp"]Steam Developer Page[/url][/b] to get automatically notified of any of my releases! ːPcatː[/p]

notes.title: Progress report: Weapon Selection
notes.content:
[p]Hi everybody! ːPhhelperː[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882185/97ac7bb84e9bbc85ee4a71578c1e75d21c624ec2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]I just wanted to do a small quick update from the development trenches — I’m currently working on the [b]weapon selection and modification system[/b]. This will let you choose your favorite tools of destruction and tweak them to suit your playstyle.[/p][p]Selecting your equipment and modifying them will give you more control over how you take down the undead.[/p][p]Everything is still work in progress but things are coming together nicely so far. notes.title: Progress report: Some new zombie types
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882185/d9957ca2f50976b671bdc4ae827d6b107e8df72c.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882185/d9957ca2f50976b671bdc4ae827d6b107e8df72c.gif[/img][/url]

Hi everybody! ːPhhelperː

A small progress update on some of the things I have been working on. I've added three new zombie types to the game: police, military, and builder zombies. Each zombie type will have some "buffs" or abilities (exploding, running etc) though these 3 are the most basic with body armour for the police, helmet for the builder and both for the military. The armour gives some small protection while the helmet have a small change to also ricochet your bullet(s). 

As of now I plan to make 3-4 more zombie types and then start on the companion dog ːPdogː 

As mentioned earlier, I plan to host a playtest followed by a demo to gather feedback and ideas. You can wishlist the game and/or join the Discord to be notified when the playtest and demo go live! ːPfrogː

notes.title: Progress report: New weapons implemented
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882185/7f2eba049c3bf28e6a9b8744fc7c59db620542e3.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882185/43b779e9340ffcb13b247ca8d04d3fb2823d8125.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882185/bc1aa8b5edb9ee47b812cebb1c29687b80bfa2d7.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882185/84a66b0a04b8d5f868af46afa703657096046126.gif[/img]

Hi everybody! ːPhhelperː

I wanted to share a progress update on the game. I’ve been working on implementing various weapon types and have so far added a pistol, shotgun, submachine gun, and rifle. Each weapon handles and animates a bit differently, and I’ve spent a lot of time fine-tuning the small details to ensure they feel satisfying to use. Having these core weapons in place will make it easier to add new models later. I plan to include at least 12 weapons in the game, but likely more, along with attachments and other upgrades.

Currently, I’m finalizing the art for different zombie types, focusing on a policeman zombie at the moment.

I’m especially excited about developing the dog companion, which I’ll work on after completing some of the zombie designs. ːPdogː 

As mentioned earlier, I plan to host a playtest followed by a demo to gather feedback and ideas. You can wishlist the game and/or join the Discord to be notified when the playtest and demo go live! ːPfrogː

notes.title: New Teaser Trailer for No Life
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/28825135/1d70c5c2a59e6b9e49a0f652006c283e62f48115.gif[/img]

Hi everybody! ːPhhelperː

As stated in my previous post, No Life is still in development, perhaps too early to be shown properly, but I still wanted to put out a short teaser trailer with some small action from the game. You can now see the teaser on the No Life Steam store page! 

Currently, the teaser only shows one weapon (the pistol) and one zombie type (the normal slow one), but I actually have four weapons and about eight different zombie types in the game currently. However, I need to create proper graphics and polish them up before I can show them, which I hope to do in the next teaser. 

I am also working on the dog companion. ːPdogː 

I plan to have a playtest and then a demo for the game later on to gather feedback and ideas. You can wishlist the game and/or join the Discord to get notified when the playtest and demo are available! ːPfrogː
